headline: Bank of Korea Board Member Warns Won Depreciation Is Faster Than Expected
summary: A Bank of Korea board member noted that recent movements in the South Korean won have occurred at a faster pace than policymakers anticipated.
why: Currency weakness raises South Korean import costs and narrows the central bank's latitude to loosen domestic monetary policy.

impacts.name: South Korean Won
impacts.why: Official central bank commentary regarding excessive foreign exchange volatility can trigger currency market positioning shifts.

why_moved: The comments from a central bank board member signaled concern over rapid currency movements, directly impacting won trading expectations.
